mapper.update: update a2a_requests set policy_version=#{request.policyVersion}, policy_snapshot_json=cast(#{request.policySnapshotJson} as jsonb), policy_snapshot_hash=#{request.policySnapshotHash}, approval_status=#{request.approvalStatus}, approval_count=#{request.approvalCount}, required_approval_count=#{request.requiredApprovalCount}, approval_actor_ids_json=cast(#{request.approvalActorIdsJson} as jsonb), request_status=#{request.requestStatus}, operational_stage=#{request.operationalStage}, blocker_code=#{request.blockerCode}, blocker_reason=#{request.blockerReason}, child_task_id=#{request.childTaskId}, rejection_reason_code=#{request.rejectionReasonCode}, updated_at=#{request.updatedAt}, expires_at=#{request.expiresAt}, version=#{request.version} where tenant_id=#{request.tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{request.requestId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from a2a_requests where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId}
select * from a2a_requests where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select * from a2a_requests where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and child_task_id=#{childTaskId}
select * from a2a_requests where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and root_task_id=#{rootTaskId} order by created_at asc limit #{limit}
select * from a2a_requests where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and source_task_id=#{sourceTaskId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
